name: Exp_MA_Rounding_Candle
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the MA_Rounding_Candle custom indicator, which applies a rounding mechanism to a smoothed moving average to generate trend signals. It opens buy positions when the trend shifts upward and sell positions when the trend shifts downward, with configurable money management and position closing logic.
summary_zh: 该EA基于MA_Rounding_Candle自定义指标的交易信号进行操作，该指标对平滑移动平均线应用舍入机制来生成趋势信号。当趋势向上转变时开多仓，趋势向下转变时开空仓，并具有可配置的资金管理和仓位关闭逻辑。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于MA_Rounding_Candle指标的趋势跟踪，该指标通过多种平滑算法（SMA、EMA、JJMA等）计算移动平均线，并对其进行舍入处理以生成更清晰的趋势信号。入场条件为：当指标第4缓冲区的TrendValue从非2变为2时开多仓，从非0变为0时开空仓，这代表了趋势方向的转变。出场条件为：当趋势反转时分别关闭多头和空头仓位，同时设置了固定的止损和止盈（默认1000点和2000点）。仓位管理采用多种资金管理模式，包括按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后余额比例以及固定手数模式。EA使用新K线检测机制避免重复信号，只在趋势确实发生转变时才触发交易，减少虚假信号的影响。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following based on the MA_Rounding_Candle indicator, which calculates a moving average using multiple smoothing algorithms (SMA, EMA, JJMA, etc.) and applies a rounding mechanism to generate cleaner trend signals. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the TrendValue from the indicator's buffer 4 transitions to 2 from a value less than 2, and a sell position is opened when it transitions to 0 from a value greater than 0, representing a shift in trend direction. Exit conditions: long and short positions are closed when the trend reverses, with fixed stop loss and take profit levels (default 1000 and 2000 points respectively). Position sizing supports multiple money management modes including percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage after loss, and fixed lot size. The EA employs a new bar detection mechanism to avoid duplicate signals, only triggering trades when a genuine trend shift occurs, which helps reduce false signals.

parameters.description_en: Money management parameter controlling position size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式（自由保证金/余额/亏损后/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode (fixed lot or margin ratio)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于检测信号的K线索引

pros: 支持多种平滑算法选择，可根据不同市场特性优化指标参数
具备完整的资金管理系统，支持多种仓位计算模式
使用新K线检测机制避免重复信号，减少过度交易
止损止盈设置合理，默认2:1的盈亏比有利于长期盈利
买卖开关独立控制，灵活性高，可只做单边交易
pros_en: Supports multiple smoothing algorithms, allowing optimization for different market characteristics
Comprehensive money management system with multiple position sizing modes
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate signals and overtrading
Reasonable stop loss and take profit with a default 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio
Independent buy/sell toggles provide high flexibility for one-directional trading
cons: 依赖自定义指标MA_Rounding_Candle，缺乏对该指标内部逻辑的透明度
止损和止盈为固定点数，未考虑市场波动性（ATR）进行动态调整
缺少点差过滤机制，高波动时段滑点可能严重影响交易结果
默认止损1000点和止盈2000点范围过大，可能不适合所有品种
未对已有持仓进行检查，可能存在重复开仓的风险
cons_en: Depends on the custom MA_Rounding_Candle indicator without transparency into its internal logic
Fixed stop loss and take profit without ATR-based dynamic adjustment for market volatility
No spread filter, slippage during high-volatility periods can significantly impact results
Default SL/TP of 1000/2000 points is very wide and may not suit all instruments
No existing position check before opening new trades, risking duplicate positions
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈功能，根据市场波动性自动调整止损止盈距离
添加持仓检查逻辑，避免在已有同方向仓位时重复开仓
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit that adjusts automatically based on market volatility
Add position checking logic to prevent duplicate entries when an existing same-direction position is already open

risk_points: 未检查已有持仓就开新仓，可能导致重复建仓和过度敞口
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动性，低波动时止损过大浪费利润空间，高波动时止盈难以到达
risk_points_en: No existing position check before opening new trades, potentially leading to duplicate positions and excessive exposure
Fixed SL/TP without volatility consideration may waste profit potential in low volatility or be unreachable in high volatility
